gaps.sentence: Never before ___ the city seen flooding on this scale.
gaps.explanation: Never before had the city seen… — past perfect inversion.

gaps.sentence: Were it not ___ the funding cuts, the library would still be open.
gaps.hint: were it not ___ = if it were not for
gaps.explanation: 'Were it not for' introduces the one thing preventing the outcome.

gaps.sentence: To ___ did you address that complaint, exactly?
Only after the third attempt ___ she pass the test.
gaps.explanation: 'Only after' at the front forces question word order: did she pass.

gaps.sentence: So ___ was the crowd that the concert was postponed.
gaps.explanation: So great was the crowd that… = the crowd was so great that…

gaps.sentence: Little ___ the chances of success be improved by patience.
gaps.explanation: Little will the chances be improved… — inversion with future.

gaps.sentence: Should you ___ any problems, call reception immediately.
gaps.explanation: Should you experience… = If you experience… — formal conditional inversion.

gaps.sentence: Never ___ I imagine the project would take two years.
gaps.explanation: Never would I have imagined… — conditional flavour with inversion.
